BBC News live page — Wednesday 30 September 2026; breaking post published 19:02 BST, latest post 19:07 BST

Dame Esther Rantzen dies aged 86

Summary
- Dame Esther Rantzen has died aged 86
- Her family have paid tribute to her as the "most wonderful mother" and a "cherished grandmother"
- This is a breaking news story

19:07 BST — Esther Rantzen's family pay tribute to 'the most wonderful mother'
In a statement, the family of Esther Rantzen have paid tribute to the "most wonderful mother" and "cherished grandmother" who will be remembered for her "endless capacity for joy".
We'll bring you more reaction shortly.

19:02 BST (Breaking) — Assisted dying campaigner and broadcaster Dame Esther Rantzen dies aged 86
Dame Esther Rantzen, the veteran broadcaster and Childline founder, has died aged 86.
Rantzen presented programme That's Life! for 21 years while at the BBC, and also appeared on Strictly Come Dancing, First Dates and I'm a Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here!
After being diagnosed with stage four lung cancer in January 2023, Rantzen went on to become a prominent campaigner in support of assisted dying.
